description: Mobile recipient album. Adds a 'View all photos' action to TripPhotosSection recipient mode (only when granted and at least one photo), a new read-only TripRecapAlbumScreen registered in YouAndCrewStack (the only navigator that registers TripRecap), the useRecapAlbum infinite query and photoKeys.recapAlbum, an extracted generic New York day grouping module, and an additive PhotoGrid tile label. Report and Block uploader only (shareId); no delete/add/uploader name. Depends on FEAT-002 (route path and TripRecapPhotosDTO) and FEAT-001 (requirement ids).
steps: Read .agents/tasks/photo-uploads/recap-album-plan.md sections 1, 2 and 6 in full before editing; confirm FEAT-002 is completed in .agents/tasks/photo-uploads/task-recap-album/features/FEAT-002.json.

apps/mobile/src/photos/dayGroups.ts (new): move getNewYorkDayKey and formatNewYorkDayHeading here and add generic groupBySortAtNewYorkDay<T extends { sortAt: string }>; update screens/trips/TripAlbumScreen.tsx to import from it, re-export getNewYorkDayKey/formatNewYorkDayHeading, and keep groupPhotosByNewYorkDay as a thin wrapper (TripAlbumScreen.test.tsx must stay green unchanged).
apps/mobile/src/photos/PhotoGrid.tsx: add optional accessibilityLabel (string | undefined) to PhotoGridItem used as tile and image label; keep the 'Guest photo' / 'Photo of <dish>' defaults.
apps/mobile/src/photos/api.ts: add photoKeys.recapAlbumAll/recapAlbum (under photoKeys.all), fetchRecapAlbum and useRecapAlbum (useInfiniteQuery, nextCursor paging, PHOTO_STALE_TIME_MS, retry false).

apps/mobile/src/photos/TripPhotosSection.tsx: optional onViewAll on the recipient variant; render 'View all photos' (testID view-all-photos-btn, role button, same style as the member's album link) only in recipient mode when onViewAll is provided and photos exist. Member mode unchanged.

apps/mobile/src/screens/share/TripRecapScreen.tsx: pass onViewAll that navigates to 'TripRecapAlbum' with { shareId, tripName } (tripName via conditional spread, exactOptionalPropertyTypes); keep its source guards green (no PhotoViewer text, TripPhotosSection mode="recipient" JSX).
apps/mobile/src/navigation/YouAndCrewStack.tsx: add TripRecapAlbum: { shareId: string; tripName?: string } to the param list and register the screen after TripRecap.

apps/mobile/src/screens/share/TripRecapAlbumScreen.tsx (new): GradientHeader 'All trip photos' (+ subtitle = trip name when known), loading / empty ('No photos to show') / error+Retry / unavailable-or-collapsed-validation_failed ('This recap is no longer available', no retry) / not_included states, day-grouped FlatList with day header + count, PhotoGrid tiles with 'Trip photo N of M, opens viewer' labels, endReached paging with next-page retry, PhotoViewer with shareId and canDelete false and onBlocked invalidating tripRecapKeys.recap(shareId). makeStyles/useAppTheme only, no raw colour literals, no uploader/delete/add code.

Tests per plan section 6 rows M1-M16: TripPhotosSection.test.tsx and TripRecapScreen.test.tsx additions, new TripRecapAlbumScreen.test.tsx, dayGroups.test.ts (+ fast-check numRuns 100 tagged Property 45 client half), PhotoGrid.test.tsx, api.test.tsx additions, navigation/__tests__/youAndCrewStack.recapAlbum.test.tsx. Mock only the network layer (jest.spyOn(clientModule, 'apiRequest')).
Inner loop: `npx jest <file>` in apps/mobile and `npm run typecheck` in apps/mobile. When done run `npm run verify:mobile` once; do NOT run the full `npm run verify` here.
Do not commit or push. Set this feature's status to completed in this file and record in findings: files changed, testIDs added, anything not verified (for example the day-count limitation).
acceptance_criteria: In recipient mode with at least one photo and onViewAll, 'View all photos' is shown; it is absent for member mode, without the callback, and when the recap access is not_included or unavailable; pressing it on TripRecapScreen navigates to TripRecapAlbum with { shareId, tripName }

TripRecapAlbumScreen requests GET /me/inbox/<shareId>/trip-recap/photos, pages with ?cursor=, groups by America/New_York day (a photo at 2026-05-02T01:30:00Z sits under May 1), shows day headers with counts, and opens the shared viewer whose only actions are Report (POST /photos/:id/report with { reason, shareId }) and Block uploader (POST /me/blocks with exactly { photoId, shareId })
No Delete, add, upload, status chip or uploader-name control exists on the screen; a source guard test pins it
Loading, empty, error+Retry, unavailable/collapsed (no Retry, one request), and not_included states render the specified copy; after a block the album is requested again
Light/dark repaint changes a concrete style value, every control has a role and label, and src/__tests__/themeRetrofit.guard.test.ts stays green
TripAlbumScreen.test.tsx passes unchanged; the real YouAndCrewStack renders the TripRecapAlbum route; npm run verify:mobile exits 0
verification: npx jest src/screens/share src/photos src/screens/trips/__tests__/TripAlbumScreen.test.tsx src/navigation (from apps/mobile)
